verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an agent identity and payments platform, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence pack documents only a dashboard, Playground, REST APIs, an MCP server and React/embed SDKs. Nothing shows an official command-line tool, and the MCP server and SDKs are separate capabilities that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
